dedupe_keys.name: building energy estimation using machine learning oslo use case

description: FAIRiCUBE publishes building-level energy-demand estimates for Oslo produced with XGBoost. The July 2025 deposit supplies Oslo_Energy_XGboost.csv under CC BY 4.0. Its stated predictors are building height, construction year and shared-wall area. The work belongs to Use Case 4, which compares neighbourhood building stock using harmonised methods across European cities. The freely downloadable table can supply estimated demand for urban energy simulations or comparison with alternative building-stock methods. It contains model predictions, not verified metered consumption. Building counts, demand units, represented weather year and prediction uncertainty remain unknown from the public description. No related catalogue record explicitly includes this Oslo output. A separate EPISCOPE estimate exists in the same project, but the two methods should not be assumed interchangeable. Neither the CSV nor the fitted model was inspected.
